name: 汽车百公里加速时间估算

map.输入整车质量、功率、传动比与轮胎参数，按扭矩段与功率段两段模型估算 0–100: Enter vehicle mass, power, gear ratio and tire parameters; a two-stage torque / power model estimates the 0–100 km/h time, gives a wheelspin verdict and compares against different power levels.
map.一档总传动比（含主减）: First gear overall ratio (incl. final drive)
map.前驱（加速时前轴载荷下降）: FWD (front axle load drops under acceleration)
map.后驱（加速时后轴载荷增加）: RWD (rear axle load rises under acceleration)
map.换挡次数 / 单次换挡耗时 (s): Number of shifts / time per shift (s)
map.上表为行业惯例量级（官方公布或实测口径），用于快速定位动力水平；本工具按两段模型: The table above gives industry rule-of-thumb levels (officially published or measured) for quickly placing a power level. This tool computes with the two-stage model, so results are relative comparisons under one set of parameters and may differ from official figures due to test conditions.
map.车速较低时受峰值扭矩与传动比限制（扭矩段），加速度基本恒定；车速升高后发动机进入: At low speed the car is limited by peak torque and gearing (torque stage) with nearly constant acceleration; at higher speed the engine enters the power-limited region where acceleration falls as speed rises, because a = P ÷ (m·v). This tool integrates both stages separately, closer to real tests than a single "average acceleration" estimate.
map.🛞 为什么大马力前驱车反而慢: 🛞 Why big-power FWD cars can be slower
map.驱动轮能传递的纵向力受附着条件限制：F ≤ μ·N，N 为驱动轮载荷。加速时载荷: Longitudinal force at the driven wheels is limited by grip: F ≤ μ·N, where N is the driven axle load. Under acceleration load shifts rearward, so front axle load drops and FWD cars easily wheelspin in first gear, sometimes with torque steer. RWD and AWD keep more load on driven wheels and use the same power more effectively.
map.本模型固定一档传动比与附着条件，因此功率大幅提升后瓶颈会转移到牵引力与附着力上—: This model fixes first-gear ratio and grip, so once power rises sharply the bottleneck moves to tractive force and grip - beyond that, adding power barely improves the time. Real performance cars raise the first-gear ratio, widen tires and optimize driven-axle load distribution, which is why "doubling power does not halve the time".
map.💡 电动车在起步即输出最大扭矩，扭矩段更宽，因此同比功率下 0–100 km/h: 💡 EVs deliver maximum torque from standstill with a wider torque stage, so at equal power-to-weight they usually beat gasoline cars to 100 km/h; yet at high speed, limited by motor power and reduction ratio, top-end acceleration drops off markedly.
map.购车横向对比时，输入功率、车重与阻力参数，估算 0–100km/h 加速时间，辅: When comparing purchases, enter power, mass and drag parameters to estimate the 0–100km/h time and judge whether the performance is enough.
map.改装前后用同一组参数对比（如刷 ECU 增功率），量化加速性能提升幅度。: Compare before and after tuning with the same parameter set (e.g. an ECU remap for more power) to quantify the acceleration gain.
map.电动车与燃油车对比时，用轮端功率与车重估算，注意电动车低速扭矩大、起步更快的特性: When comparing EVs and gasoline cars, estimate from wheel power and mass, allowing for the fact that EVs make huge low-speed torque and launch faster.
map.两段模型估算 0–100 km/h: Estimating 0–100 km/h with the two-stage model
map.整车质量 1500 kg、最大功率 130 kW、峰值扭矩 250 N·m、一档: Vehicle mass 1500 kg, maximum power 130 kW, peak torque 250 N·m, first gear overall ratio 12, tire rolling radius 0.32 m, drivetrain efficiency 88%, drag CdA 0.65, FWD, grip coefficient 0.9: wheel power = 130 × 0.88 = 114.4 kW, maximum first-gear wheel force = 250 × 12 × 0.88 ÷ 0.32 = 8250 N. The torque stage 0~49.9 km/h at about 4.86 m/s² (capped by FWD grip) takes 2.86 s; the power stage 49.9~100 km/h takes 4.09 s; two shift interruptions cost 0.7 s, totaling about 7.65 s,
map.3.63 m/s²，比功率 86.7 kW/t。若附着系数降到 0.5，附着上限: 3.63 m/s², power-to-weight 86.7 kW/t. If grip drops to 0.5, the grip ceiling falls to 2.70 m/s² and the same power stretches the estimate to about 9.94 s.
map.为什么估算值常比官方快？: Why is the estimate often quicker than the official figure?
map.官方 0–100km/h 多在理想路面、一档到底或弹射起步测得，且取多次最好成绩: Official 0–100km/h runs are measured on ideal surfaces, held in first gear or launched with launch control, and take the best of several attempts. Counting drivetrain loss, wheelspin and shift interruption brings everyday estimates closer to reality; high-power cars spin more and diverge further.
map.车重和功率哪个影响更大？: Which matters more, mass or power?
map.加速能力近似由功率质量比（比功率，kW/t）决定。同功率下车越重越慢；同车重下功: Acceleration is governed roughly by power-to-mass ratio (kW/t). At equal power a heavier car is slower; at equal mass more power is quicker. About 80 kW/t corresponds to 7–8 s to 100, while 120 kW/t enters the 5 s class.
map.估算已计入滚动阻力、空气阻力与换挡中断；起步若超出附着上限会打滑，实际时间更长: Estimates include rolling resistance, air drag and shift interruption; exceeding the grip limit at launch causes wheelspin and a longer real time
